description: File inventory, hashing, and manifest building. Builds a structured manifest of a directory tree with SHA-256 hashes and file type classification. Provides safe ZIP extraction with path-traversal protection.
function: File hashing, manifest building, ZIP safe extraction

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File path for sha256_file or kind_for

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Root directory for build_manifest or write_manifest

outputs.name: sha256_file
outputs.description: SHA-256 digest prefixed with 'sha256:' or None if file missing

outputs.name: sha256_bytes
outputs.description: SHA-256 digest of bytes, prefixed with 'sha256:'

outputs.name: build_manifest
outputs.description: List of file entry dicts with relpath, name, kind, ext, size_bytes, sha256

outputs.name: aggregate_hash
outputs.description: Deterministic aggregate SHA-256 over all manifest entries

outputs.name: write_manifest
outputs.description: Manifest dict written to JSON and CSV in out_dir

public_api.name: sha256_file
public_api.description: Compute SHA-256 of a file. Returns None if file does not exist.

public_api.name: sha256_bytes
public_api.description: Compute SHA-256 of raw bytes, returning 'sha256:<hex>' string.

public_api.name: kind_for
public_api.description: Classify a file by extension. Returns type string or 'unknown'.

public_api.name: build_manifest
public_api.description: Recursively build a manifest of all files under root with SHA-256 hashes.

public_api.name: aggregate_hash
public_api.description: Compute a deterministic aggregate SHA-256 over a manifest entry list.

public_api.name: write_manifest
public_api.signature: write_manifest(root: Path, out_dir: Path, label: str = 'manifest') -> Dict[str, Any]
public_api.description: Build and write manifest as both JSON and CSV files to out_dir.

public_api.name: safe_extract_zip
public_api.description: Extract ZIP to dest with path-traversal protection. Returns list of extracted paths.
